privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.storeBody: Your name, email address, a hashed (never plain-text) password, and anything you explicitly add to your profile (bio, avatar, interests, preferred languages). Posts, comments, likes, bookmarks, and follows you create are stored to power the features you use.
privacy.cookiesBody: We use browser local storage only for essentials: your login session, and your theme/language/font-size preferences. We don't use third-party advertising or tracking cookies.
privacy.visibilityBody: BlogManthan requires an account to read or write anything — there is no public, logged-out access. Your published posts, name, avatar, and bio are visible to other logged-in members. Your email address is never shown to other users.
privacy.controlsBody: You can edit or delete any post or comment you've written, mute individual notification types, enable two-factor authentication, and download is not yet available but full account deletion is: deleting your account from the Profile page permanently removes your posts, comments, and personal data.
privacy.thirdPartyBody: We don't sell or share your data with advertisers. If you enable optional integrations in the future (e.g. social login), those providers' own privacy policies would apply to that connection.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.accountBody: You must provide accurate information when creating an account and are responsible for activity that happens under it. Keep your password (and, if enabled, your two-factor codes) confidential.
terms.contentBody1: You retain ownership of what you write. By publishing on BlogManthan, you grant other logged-in members permission to read, comment on, and share links to your posts within the platform.
terms.contentBody2: You're responsible for your own content. Don't post anything unlawful, harassing, or infringing on someone else's rights. We may remove content or accounts that violate these terms, based on reports reviewed by moderators.
terms.accessBody: Reading and posting on BlogManthan requires a logged-in account — there is no public, unauthenticated access to content on this platform.
terms.terminationBody: You may delete your account at any time from your Profile page, which permanently removes your posts, comments, and account data. We may suspend or remove accounts that violate these terms.
terms.warrantyBody: The service is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. We aren't liable for any damages arising from your use of the platform.
